title: Serialize host-only daemon integration tests within one process
goal: Prevent host-only daemon integration tests from racing their process-global environment and child-daemon lifecycle when libtest runs them concurrently.

results.runner_shape: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test host_only_privacy -- --test-threads=4: 2 passed, 0 failed
results.fix: A process-local mutex serializes the two tests that share environment and daemon lifecycle state.
